actions.description: Move one stage axis to an absolute position in micrometres

inputs.description: Software stage axis to move (x, y or z)
inputs.name: axis

inputs.description: Absolute target position of the axis in micrometres
inputs.name: position

actions.name: move_axis_absolute

outputs.description: Absolute position the axis reports after the move
outputs.name: position

actions.description: Stop a running line scan (the native scan stop); it takes no input
actions.name: stop_scan

outputs.description: True once the scan stop was sent
outputs.name: stopped

facts.text: MS2000Stage maps the software axes x, y and z to the controller axes X, Y and Z by default
get_axis_position asks the controller for the axis position in micrometres (get_axis_position_um) and returns inf when the axis has no mapping
The stage holds its axis positions in microns (x_pos, y_pos, ...; 'All units are in microns')
The per-axis travel bounds x_min and x_max are read from the microscope stage configuration
move_axis_absolute sends the target multiplied by 10 because the ASI controller unit is 1/10 micrometre
move_absolute takes positions in micrometres for the ASI API
stop() sends the controller stop command and aborts all stage movement
stop_scan() sends the controller scan stop command
connect() opens the Tiger controller over serial for the stage

operator_required.name: move_axis_absolute
operator_required.reason: the axis travel range is a property of the installed stage and its site microscope configuration (x_min/x_max, stage/base.py:150-158); no text of the clone states one, so the site supplies it

safe_state.description: all stage axes halted (the ASI controller stop command)
